idea-plugin.name: Firestore Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Browse Firestore data in a tool window, signed in with a service account key. The IDE calls Firestore's REST API directly: no proxy, no telemetry, and every network call runs off the UI thread.

Free

  • Connect with a service account JSON key and a project ID. A malformed key is reported by the exact missing or invalid field.
  • Local Firestore emulator: connect by host and port (localhost:8080), with no service account.
  • Collections and documents in a table, with drill-down into each document's subcollections.
  • The key's contents and the access token stay in memory. Only the key's file path and the project ID are saved.

Firestore Companion Pro (paid, with a free trial)

  • Edit in place string, integer, double and boolean fields.
  • Saved connection profiles to switch between dev, staging and prod without retyping.
  • Query builder (field, operator, value) on Firestore's structured-query endpoint, instead of listing a whole collection.
  • Export a collection to JSON, keeping Firestore's typed values so int64 numbers keep full precision.

Editing was free before version 2026.2.0. Any installation that runs version 2026.2.0 or later before November 2, 2026 keeps it without a license.
